methodology: Direct, exchange-operated fiat rails (exchange cash wallet / native bank transfer integrations). Fee objects combine an optional percentage (pct) and fixed fee in the route currency, with optional min/max fee floors and caps. Third-party checkout gateways (Banxa, Simplex, MoonPay, Mercuryo, Zen, Advcash: typically 1.99%-5.5% for cards) are EXCLUDED because quotes vary by user region and order size and are shown at checkout; the card rows reflect each exchange's headline direct card rate. P2P/C2C (zero platform fee, cost embedded in the merchant quote spread) is excluded. Fees charged by the user's own bank (wire/SWIFT sender fees, FX conversion) are excluded. Fixed fees are denominated in the route's fiat currency. Cash-out to card is unavailable at most venues; route direction is null where the exchange does not operate that leg. Availability of every rail depends on KYC and residency; verify on the withdrawal screen before moving large amounts.
